title: fix(plugin-chatbot): leave the tool-loading step out of the phase line
body:
Fixes #13038
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The chat's phase line (the collapsed step summary, `ToolPhaseSummary` in `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`) no longer shows or counts the build agent's `load_tools` step.

- `foldToolPhaseSteps` skips plumbing calls, so the step text has no "Load more tools" (zh 「加载更多工具」) entry and the step count drops by one.
- The expanded rows under the chevron skip it too, so the step is shown nowhere in the phase.
- A phase that so far called only plumbing draws no line, instead of "0 steps" over an empty step list. The phase clock still starts with the turn, because the hooks run before the early return.
- Every other step, count and row reads exactly as before.

## Why a client list, measured first

The ruling asked for a declared signal first. There is none:

- The spec's `ToolSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts`, read at the objectstack commit this repo pins, `2c9bf9430a`) is strict. Its keys are `name`, `label`, `description`, `parameters`, `outputSchema`, `objectName` and `protection`. None of them marks a tool as internal.
- Cloud's `loadToolsTool` (`packages/service-ai-studio/src/tools/load-tools.tool.ts`) is a `defineTool` with only `name`, `label`, `description` and `parameters`. The plan's `unlockToolName` names it, but only on the server, in `BUILD_TOOL_OFFER_PLAN`. Nothing carries that to the client.
- The tool part the chat receives (AI SDK v6, mapped by `mapMessages.ts` into `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation`) carries `toolCallId`, `toolName`, `args`, `result`, `errorText`, `state`, `approval` and ObjectStack's lifted envelopes. None of them marks plumbing.

Declaring it would need a new spec key or a tool-contract field. The ruling did not call for that. So, as the ruling allows, a module-private set `PLUMBING_TOOL_NAMES` holds `load_tools` only, and a comment gives the reason. Nothing is exported: no new export, prop, type member or language-pack key.

## Tests

Final head `fe4cad5307`.

- New `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.plumbingStep-13038.test.tsx`, rendered through the shipped zh pack:
  - (a) The card's data turn with `load_tools` reads 「4 步」 and 「列出已有对象 ×2 · 查看对象的结构 ×2 · 汇总相关数据 · 查找相关记录 ×3」. No tool-loading step appears in the line or in the expanded rows.
  - (b) CONTROL: the headline, step text and expanded rows are byte-equal to the same turn without `load_tools`.
  - (c) A settled phase and a running phase of only `load_tools` draw no `tool-phase` element, no "0 步" and no 「加载更多工具」.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1` on the new test file and `ChatbotEnhanced.buildChat-12724.test.tsx` at `fe4cad5307`: 2 files, 13 tests passed.
- The whole `packages/plugin-chatbot/` directory at `8e5efb70d8`: 77 files, 763 tests passed. The only later commit rewrites two code comments in English.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot run type-check` passed at `fe4cad5307`, after the dependency closure was built. `tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new test.

Ablation, once per behaviour. Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs`, which checks that the anchor hit and the blob changed. Each restore was proven by the blob hash equalling HEAD's (`fd91c5c2c156`) and by an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- Drop the fold's skip: (a) and (b) go red. The headline reads 「5 步」 where 「4 步」 was expected. (c) stays green, because the rows filter still empties it.
- Drop the rows filter: (a), (b) and (c) all go red.
- Drop the early return: (c) goes red, and (a) and (b) stay green.

Gates. The exit codes are recorded, and every one is 0:

- The pre-tsc battery: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity` and `control-bytes`.
- `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check:new-line-citations`.

Lint was narrowed to the two changed source files. The run was `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` at `fe4cad5307`: 2 files, 0 errors and 11 warnings. The warnings sit on code this PR does not touch. The population is the root `eslint.config.js`, which lints both paths. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware. That means this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch. The full `pnpm lint` is declared to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- A phase where `load_tools` sits only beside tools that have their own card (the plan, a draft) now draws no line. The host already draws none for a turn of only carded tools, so a lone card is not named twice. No test pins this case.
- A `load_tools` call that fails no longer shows a failed row in the phase. The agent's next step, or its answer, carries that failure.
- `processVisibility: 'debug'` still lists every tool, `load_tools` included. That is by design, and this PR leaves it unchanged.
- If a tool definition someday declares its plumbing role, the private set should give way to that declaration. That would be a spec or tool-contract decision. This PR does not make it.

Changeset: `.changeset/13038-tool-loading-step-hidden.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` patch.
